home.title: Home
home.subtitle: Starting point for VOD analysis and your token usage at a glance.

newProject.title: New project
newProject.subtitle: VOD preview, Eco / Standard / Quality mode and cost estimate.

analysis.title: Analysis
analysis.subtitle: Local signals followed by Gemini editorial triage, resumable after interruption.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.subtitle: Waveform, chat density, muted ranges and highlight markers.
timeline.emptyDesc: The timeline appears here as soon as a VOD has been analyzed.

review.title: Clip review
review.subtitle: 9:16 grid, keyboard triage and subtitle editing.

export.title: Export queue
export.subtitle: 1080×1920 rendering, loudness normalized to −14 LUFS and caption export.

costs.title: Costs & tokens
costs.subtitle: Per project and per stage, cache hits and budget cap.
costs.emptyDesc: Usage statistics will fill in after the first API call.

onboarding.title: First launch
onboarding.subtitle: Install FFmpeg, yt-dlp, TwitchDownloaderCLI and whisper.cpp, verified by SHA-256.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Appearance, language, Gemini API key and local diagnostics.
settings.appearanceDesc: Saved in SQLite and applied to the Windows window material.
settings.diagnosticsDesc: Status of the Rust core, the SQLite database and the data folder.

gemini.title: Gemini API (Google AI Studio)
